name: Easy Mode
text: Setup: Players prepare their fleet. Prepare the Corsair deck. Set the following enemies aside: all 7 unique enemies (including the Dreadnaught), 2 copies of Black Sails, and 1 copy of Corsair Warship. Add the Cobas Haven location to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck. Add 1 resource to each hero's resource pool. Flip this card over and place it next to the quest deck.
back_text:
Each player draws 1 additional card during the resource phase.
Quest Action: Deal 10 damage to a non-unique enemy engaged with a player in any group. (Group limit once per game.)
If a player controls no ship-objective, that player is eliminated from the game.

name: Easy Mode
text:

name: Standard Mode
text: Setup: Players prepare their fleet. Prepare the Corsair deck. Set aside all 7 unique enemies (including the Dreadnaught). Shuffle the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until 2 locations are discarded (3 locations instead if there are 3 or more players). Add those locations to the staging area. Flip this card over and place it next to the quest deck.
back_text:
Quest Action: Deal 10 damage to a non-unique enemy engaged with a player in any group. Reveal the top card of the encounter deck. (Group limit once per game.)
If a player controls no ship-objective, that player is eliminated from the game.

name: Standard Mode
text:

name: Hard Mode
text: Setup: Players prepare their fleet. Prepare the Corsair deck. Set aside all 7 unique enemies (including the Dreadnaught). Add 3 Tolfalas Landing locations to the staging area (3 Tolfalas Landing locations and 2 Wicked Cove locations instead if there are 3 or more players). Shuffle the encounter deck. Flip this card over and place it next to the quest deck.
back_text:
Each player's threat cannot be reduced by more than 1 each round.
Forced: After a character is healed or readied by a player card effect, its controller raises their threat by 1.
If a player controls no ship-objective, that player is eliminated from the game.

name: Gondorian Warship
text:
Immune to player card effects. Ranged. Sentinel.
When Revealed: Choose a player. That player gains control of Gondorian Warship.
Forced: When Gondorian Warship is destroyed, set it aside, out of play.
shadow: Shadow: Deal 5 damage to attacking enemy.

name: Dreadnaught
text:
Archery 1 per player. Massive. Immune to player card effects. Cannot take more than 5 damage per player each round.
*The Dreadnaught has a global hit point value of 15 per player among all groups.
Forced: At the end of the round, if the Dreadnaught has less than half of its starting hit points, flip it over.
back_text:
Massive. Immune to player card effects. Cannot take more than 5 damage per player each round.
*The Dreadnaught has a global hit point value of 15 per player among all groups.
Forced: After the Dreadnaught flips, each player puts 1 set-aside unique Corsair enemy into play at random engaged with them.

name: Dreadnaught
text:
Massive. Immune to player card effects. Cannot take more than 5 damage per player each round.
*The Dreadnaught has a global hit point value of 15 per player among all groups.
Forced: After the Dreadnaught flips, each player puts 1 set-aside unique Corsair enemy into play at random engaged with them.

name: Captain of the Haven
text:
Immune to player card effects. Pillage 8.
Engaged player cannot attack the Dreadnaught.
Forced: At the end of the combat phase, if engaged player has no cards in their deck, that player is eliminated from the game.

name: Commander of the Dreadnaught
text:
Immune to player card effects.
Engaged player cannot attack the Dreadnaught.
Forced: After Commander of the Dreadnaught attacks you, the Dreadnaught attacks you.

name: Descendant of Castamir
text:
Immune to player card effects.
Engaged player cannot attack the Dreadnaught.
Forced: After Descendant of Castamir engages you, put the top 2 cards of the Corsair deck into play engaged with you and deal each of them 1 shadow card.

name: Hydraken
text:
Immune to player card effects.
Engaged player cannot attack the Dreadnaught.
Forced: After Hydraken attacks, he makes an additional attack. Deal him 2 additional shadow cards for this attack and engaged player raises their threat by 4. (Limit once per round.)

name: Ophidian
text:
Immune to player card effects. No more than 1 character can attack Ophidian each round.
Engaged player cannot attack the Dreadnaught.
Forced: When a character defends against Ophidian, deal 2 damage to that character.

name: Varjax
text:
Archery 3. Immune to player card effects.
Engaged player cannot attack the Dreadnaught.
For each point of excess combat damage dealt by Varjax, defending player deals 1 damage to a Ship they control.

name: Brash Corsair
text: Forced: When engaged player exhausts a Ship objective, Brash Corsair attacks that player.

name: Corsair Plunderer
text:
Pillage 2. (After this enemy attacks you, discard the top 2 cards of your deck.)
Forced: After an event card is discarded from your deck by Corsair Plunderer's Pillage keyword, discard an attachment you control.

name: Daring Buccaneer
text:
Pillage 3. (After this enemy attacks you, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.)
Forced: After an event card is discarded from your deck by Daring Buccaneer's Pillage keyword, deal 1 damage to a character you control.

name: Fierce Marauder
text:
Pillage 3. (After this enemy attacks you, discard the top 3 cards of your deck.)
Forced: After an event card is discarded from your deck by Fierce Marauder's Pillage keyword, discard 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero you control.

name: Southron Sailor
text: While Southron Sailor is engaged with you, each Ship enemy engaged with you contributes its [threat] to the total [threat] in the staging area.

name: Umbar Captain
text: Engaged player cannot attack Ship enemies.

name: Black Sails
text:
Boarding 2. Cannot have attachments.
While Black Sails is in the staging area, it gains Archery 3.
shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy is a Ship, return it to the staging area after this attack.

name: Corsair Skiff
text:
Surge. Cannot have attachments.
Forced: When Corsair Skiff engages you from the staging area, either raise your threat by 3 or it gains Boarding 1.

name: Corsair Skirmisher
text:
Boarding 1. Immune to player card effects.
Response: After Corsair Skirmisher is destroyed as an enemy, the engaged player may discard allies they control with a total of at least 3 [willpower] to take control of Corsair Skirmisher as a ship-objective with [willpower] equal to its [threat]. (It loses the ship-enemy card type and gains the ship-objective card type).

name: Corsair Warship
text:
Boarding 3. Cannot have attachments.
While Corsair Warship is in the staging area, it cannot be damaged and gains Archery 4.

name: Ramming Ship
text:
Cannot have attachments.
Forced: After Ramming Ship engages you, it gets +4 [attack] until the end of the round.
shadow: Shadow: Put the top card of the Corsair deck into play engaged with you and deal it 1 shadow card.

name: Slave Ship
text:
Boarding 1. Cannot have attachments.
For each point of damage that is dealt to a Ship objective by Slave Ship's attack, deal 1 point of damage to a non-Ship character controlled by the defending player, as well.

name: War Galley
text:
Archery 2. Boarding 1. Cannot have attachments.
Forced: When War Galley engages you from the staging area, either raise your threat by 4 or it gains Boarding 1.

name: Sea Monster
text:
Ship objectives may attack and defend against Sea Monster.
When Revealed: Deal 4 damage to the Ship enemy or Ship objective with the fewest remaining hit points.

name: Belfalas Shipyard
text: Response: After Belfalas Shipyard is explored as the active location, the players as a group spend 5 resources to heal 5 damage from a Ship objective in any group. Ready that Ship and flip it to its Upgraded side.
shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] and gains Pillage 3.

name: Cobas Haven
text: While Cobas Haven is the active location, reduce the Boarding value on each Ship enemy by 1.

name: Isle of Fortune
text:
Isle of Fortune enters play with 1 resource per player on it.
Forced: After a Ship enemy enters play, discard 1 resource from Isle of Fortune.
Response: When Isle of Fortune is explored as the active location, move each resource on it to a hero's resource pool.

name: Mouths of Anduin
text: While Mouths of Anduin is in the staging area, it gains: "Forced: After a 'when revealed' effect is canceled, reveal the top card of the encounter deck."
shadow: Shadow: If this attack is undefended, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

name: Tolfalas Landing
text: While Tolfalas Landing is in the staging area, it gains: "Forced: After a player draws any number of cards from a player card effect, that player raises their threat by that number."
shadow: Shadow: Raise your threat by 1 (3 instead if you have 5 or more cards in hand).

name: Wicked Cove
text: Each location in the staging area is immune to player card effects.
shadow: Shadow: Until the end of the round, attacking enemy is immune to player card effects and gets +2 [defense].

name: Ballista Barrage
text:
Doomed 1. (Raise each player's threat by 1.)
When Revealed: Until the end of the round, each Ship enemy gains Archery 2.
shadow: Shadow: Assign 2 damage among characters you control (3 damage instead if there are 10 or more cards in your discard pile).

name: Boarding Party
text: When Revealed: Each player puts the top card of the Corsair deck into play engaged with them.
shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if you control an exhausted Ship objective).

name: Grappled!
text: When Revealed: Attach to a Ship objective. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached objective cannot ready. Action: Exhaust 3 characters to discard Grappled!")
shadow: Shadow: If defending character is a Ship, attach Grappled! to it.

name: Out of the Mist
text: When Revealed: The enemy with the highest engagement cost engages the first player and attacks them. If no attack is made this way, Out of the Mist gains surge.
shadow: Shadow: Either raise your threat by 4 or attacking enemy makes an additional attack.

name: Overworked
text: When Revealed: Until the end of the round, treat the text box of each non-Ship ally as blank, except for Traits. If a player controls 7 or more allies, Overworked gains surge.
shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if you control 7 or more allies).

name: Taking on Water
text: When Revealed: Attach to a Ship objective. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: When attached objective exhausts, deal 2 damage to it. Action: Exhaust 3 characters to discard Taking on Water.")
shadow: Shadow: If defending character is a Ship, attach Taking on Water to it.

name: Violent Tempest
text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each enemy. Each player assigns X damage among characters they control. X is the number of exhausted characters they control.
shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to defending character.
